2ba2326317af8af1.description: Function: Product · 1 opening · Riyadh About SHIFTER SHIFTER is a Saudi B2B delivery orchestration platform. We connect merchants with licensed delivery operators through one platform: a direct technical integration, a prepaid account, transparent pricing, and a service level that is agreed upfront and reported every month. We own no fleet and employ no drivers. We start in Riyadh. The role You will own SHIFTER's platform end to end: the merchant API and integrations, the merchant dashboard, the prepaid wallet, the rate-card engine, operator dispatch and the SLA engine. You decide what we build and in what order, write the specs, lead the engineering team through delivery, and answer for the results in production. You report to the CEO. What you will do Own the product roadmap and backlog for the merchant, operator and internal surfaces, ranked by measurable impact on activation, order volume, SLA and margin. Discover needs directly: at least 6 merchant or operator interviews a month, plus order and funnel data, before anything enters the backlog. Write clear specs and acceptance criteria (user stories, API contracts, edge cases, failure states) that engineers can build from without guessing. Run delivery with the engineering team in two-week sprints: planning, refinement, acceptance and release, with a release you can name every sprint. Define and track product KPIs: time to integrate a merchant, order success rate, on-time delivery against SLA, wallet top-up rate and support tickets per 1,000 orders. Make pricing rules, SLA rules and settlement (T+5) configurable and auditable, together with the Pricing Specialist and finance. Keep the platform ready for regulatory and data requirements (Transport General Authority licensing, PDPL) with compliance before launch. What you bring 5+ years in product ownership or product management, including at least 3 years on a live B2B platform, marketplace, logistics, delivery, fintech or API product in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. You have shipped products to production yourself and can show, with numbers, the result of at least two releases you owned (adoption, conversion, retention, cost or time saved). Strong technical fluency: you read API documentation, design REST endpoints and webhooks with engineers, and write SQL to answer your own questions. Hands-on agile delivery with a backlog tool (Jira, Linear or similar); a Scrum Product Owner certification (PSPO or CSPO) is a plus, not a substitute for results. Experience with dispatch, order management, payments or wallet systems is a strong advantage. Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken. Based in Riyadh, on site. What we offer Competitive base salary plus performance-linked incentives. A founding role with direct impact on the company's growth and a clear path to leadership. Medical insurance and benefits in line with Saudi Labour Law. A professional culture built on numbers, transparency and ownership. How to apply Apply with your CV and a short note covering three things: a link to or description of a live product you owned, your exact role in it, and one metric it moved with the before and after numbers. Applications without this note will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates complete a written product case (48 hours) before any interview, followed by a technical session with our engineers and a final interview with the CEO. نبحث عن مواهب سعودية وخليجية وعربية متميزة في إدارة المنتجات الرقمية. الإعلان بالإنجليزية والعمل باللغتين.

2b754042e8c39e87.description: We are delighted to be working with a Riyadh-based hospitality investment group on the appointment of a Head Chef for a premium, chef-led French restaurant in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The restaurant is the Riyadh home of an internationally recognised all-day French dining brand, with established restaurants in Dubai and London. Its menu runs from boulangerie and viennoiserie in the morning to brasserie dining at night, and the role offers the chance to set the kitchen standard for the brand in one of the most dynamic dining markets in the region, with a strong tax-free package and family sponsorship. Reporting to the General Manager, with culinary direction from the Group Executive Chef and ownership, the Head Chef leads the Sous Chefs, Chefs de Partie, Pastry Chef and kitchen stewarding team. Responsibilities Execute the menu to brand specification, ensuring consistency of taste, presentation and portioning on every plate. Lead menu development and seasonal changes with the Group Executive Chef and General Manager, including costing and recipe documentation. Run tastings, maintain recipe cards and photo standards, and train the team on every dish. Oversee pastry, bakery and in-house production to the same standard. Own full compliance with HACCP and Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) requirements, municipal inspections and hygiene certification. Maintain temperature logs, cleaning schedules, allergen records and traceability documentation. Ensure all ingredients and suppliers meet halal and local regulatory requirements. Deliver food cost targets agreed with the General Manager, monitoring daily and reporting weekly. Manage purchasing specifications, supplier selection and goods receiving with the purchasing team. 2beebc663189c7e6.description: Who are we? PAVIGYM is a global leader in high-end gym flooring and high-performance surfaces. With over 60 years of experience, more than 5 million m² of flooring installed worldwide, and a presence in over 100 countries, we are proud to continue growing thanks to innovation, quality, and our passion for creating better training spaces. Behind everything we do is a team that believes in collaboration, respect, responsibility, and positive energy. Why join our team? We are accelerating our growth in the Middle East and Africa, a region with great potential in the fitness sector. This is a high-impact sales leadership role that offers the opportunity to strengthen our partner network, develop key strategic accounts, and open new markets throughout the region. You’ll work with a portfolio of premium products, an international brand, and a clear mission: to achieve sustainable and profitable growth by establishing strong distribution partnerships and creating long-term value for key customers. In addition, you’ll be part of an international team where collaboration, commitment, and continuous improvement are integral to our daily work. What kind of person are we looking for? At PAVIGYM, we know that great results come from great people, not just great résumés. We’re looking for someone who combines strategic business acumen with the energy and initiative needed to grow the business. You’re confident in developing a network of distributors and key accounts, comfortable working in multicultural environments, and disciplined when it comes to turning market opportunities into a structured project portfolio. You communicate clearly, manage complexity well, and stay focused on profitable and sustainable growth. Above all, you represent PAVIGYM with professionalism, credibility, and positive energy. What will your role be? As Sales Director for the Middle East and Africa region, you’ll lead the development of PAVIGYM’s distribution network, strategic accounts, and new business opportunities across the territory. Your main mission will be to grow revenue, margins, and market presence while ensuring strong coordination between regional partners and HQ. In this role, you’ll be responsible for: Distribution Channel Management & Development Lead the recruitment, development and performance evaluation of distributors and regional partners. Formalise partnership agreements and implement a management model based on key performance indicators (pipeline, opportunity conversion, stock availability, market penetration and presence). Ensure compliance with the company’s commercial, operational and brand positioning standards. Develop distributors’ commercial, technical and management capabilities to maximise their performance and commitment to Pavigym. Key Account Management & Development Develop and strengthen commercial relationships with the region’s leading operators and strategic accounts. Lead the definition and execution of account development plans, establishing objectives, milestones, product strategy and key decision-maker mapping. Coordinate the commercial strategy and operational activity of key accounts in collaboration with regional distributors. Identify, develop and accelerate business opportunities linked to high-value strategic projects and accounts. Business Development Drive the expansion and development of new markets within the assigned territory. Identify, recruit and develop new strategic distributors, partners and resellers. Build collaborative relationships with industry specifiers and influencers, including architects, designers, consultants and equipment manufacturers, to drive opportunity generation. Develop the pipeline of acoustic flooring projects in collaboration with consultants and specialist companies in the local market. Lead the development of high-value vertical segments, with a particular focus on Hospitality, Hotels, Wellness and major international operators. Represent the company at trade fairs, events and other relevant industry activities within the territory. Coordination with HQ Prepare reliable demand forecasts and anticipate risks related to product availability and supply capacity. Coordinate technical, commercial, logistics and service requirements arising from activities within the territory with corporate teams. Act as the key link between the market and the organisation, ensuring effective communication and appropriate management of priorities and escalations. Provide sales forecasts, regular reporting and ongoing monitoring of strategic opportunities across the territory. What will help you succeed in this role? Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. More than 5 years of experience in international B2B sales, preferably in a high-end, technical, or specification-based product category. Proven experience in the fitness, wellness, sports equipment, flooring, or related industries, as well as in-depth knowledge of the fitness sector in the Middle East and Africa, including key market dynamics, major players, distribution models, and business culture across the region. Proven experience and established contacts with distributor networks and key accounts across multiple markets in the Middle East and Africa. Experience in establishing and tracking partners’ key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue targets, inventory management, training, project portfolio development, and performance evaluations. Strong ability to identify, initiate, and develop strategic opportunities with key accounts. Strong project portfolio management skills, discipline in forecasting, and the ability to prepare CRM reports. Full professional proficiency in English. It would be even better if: You speak an additional language relevant to the region. You have an established network among distributors, gym operators, hotel groups, architects, designers, consultants, or equipment manufacturers in the Middle East and Africa. You have experience selling premium, technical, specification-led, or project-based products. What can you expect from us? The opportunity to lead the commercial development of a strategic international region. A premium product portfolio with strong differentiation in the fitness flooring market. The chance to work with leading fitness operators, franchise networks, and distributors across ME and Africa. A collaborative international team and direct exposure to senior leadership. A competitive compensation package including a fixed salary and a variable incentive plan linked to regional performance. If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’re looking for, and you’re ready to help build and grow PAVIGYM’s presence across ME & Africa, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s talk!

2bde1fae8801bd9e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة الماجد للعود عن حاجتها لمسؤول جرد بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ ومتابعة عمليات الجرد الدوري والمفاجئ للمخزون والأصول، مع ضمان دقة السجلات ومطابقتها مع الأنظمة المعتمدة. كما يشمل الكشف عن الفروقات وتحليل أسبابها، مما يسهم في تعزيز الرقابة وتقليل الفاقد وتحسين كفاءة إدارة المخزون. المهام التشغيلية الرئيسية مطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الأنظمة (ERP / نظام المخزون). التنسيق مع مديري المستودعات والفروع أثناء تنفيذ عمليات الجرد. إعداد تقارير تفصيلية بنتائج الجرد ورفعها للإدارة المختصة. التحقق من الالتزام بإجراءات التخزين والصرف المعتمدة. المساهمة في تحسين ضوابط الرقابة على المخزون وتقليل الهدر والفاقد. إعداد التقارير عن حالة المنتجات المخزنة وأماكن التخزين. تنفيذ عمليات الجرد الدوري والمفاجئ حسب الخطة المعتمدة من إدارة المخزون. عدّ الأصناف فعليًا بدقة عالية وتسجيل نتائج الجرد كما هي دون تعديل أو تفسير. توثيق عمليات الجرد بمحاضر رسمية حسب الإجراءات المعتمدة وبشكل كامل وصحيح وواضح. إعداد مستندات الاستلام والتسليم الخاصة بالجرد وتوقيعها من الأطراف المعنية. رفع نتائج الجرد ومرفقاتها (نماذج، محاضر، مستندات استلام وتسليم) أولًا بأول إلى إدارة المخزون. التنسيق الميداني مع أمناء المستودعات أو الفروع أثناء تنفيذ الجرد وفق الصلاحيات. إعادة العد عند الطلب أو في حال الاشتباه دون اتخاذ أي إجراء تصحيحي ذاتي. الاحتفاظ بنسخ من مستندات الجرد حسب السياسات المعتمدة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الالتزام بسياسات الشركة وإجراءاتها ومعايير التدقيق الداخلي. الالتزام التام بتعليمات وإجراءات الجرد المعتمدة دون اجتهاد أو تجاوز. المحافظة على سرية بيانات الجرد وعدم الإفصاح عنها إلا للجهات المخولة. الالتزام بالجدول الزمني المحدد لكل عملية جرد وعدم التأخير في التنفيذ أو الرفع. تطوير العمليات اتباع جميع السياسات والعمليات وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية والتعليمات ذات الصلة وضمان تنفيذ العمل بطريقة متسقة ومسيطر عليها. المساهمة في تحديد فرص التحسين المستمر للأنظمة والعمليات والممارسات، مع مراعاة الممارسات الرائدة، وتحسين العمليات التجارية، وخفض التكاليف وتحسين الإنتاجية. تعزيز التنفيذ والالتزام بالسياسات ذات الصلة والعمليات وإجراءات التشغيل للآخرين. بيئة العمل يعمل مسؤول الجرد ضمن فريق شركة الماجد للعود في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان كفاءة إدارة المخزون. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يمتلكون المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة.

2b92e9076ce585b0.description: About ASMO ASMO is a joint venture between DHL and Saudi Aramco, established to redefine the procurement and supply chain landscape. Leveraging DHL’s logistics expertise and Saudi Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem, ASMO aims to set new benchmarks in the industry. The company is projected to be operational in 2025, providing integrated procurement and supply chain services across industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors. Initially, ASMO will focus on Saudi Aramco and its affiliates, with long-term plans to expand to all industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia and eventually the MENA region. The Role of IT Project Management Analyst The IT Project Management Analyst at ASMO is responsible for planning, executing, and managing technology projects under the guidance of the IT PMO Manager. This full-time role, based in Saudi Arabia, focuses on ensuring projects are completed successfully, on time, within budget, and meet their specified objectives. The analyst coordinates project activities, manages resources and stakeholders, and monitors performance throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Contribute to defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria. Assist in developing detailed project plans, including timelines, resources, budget, risks, and dependencies. Coordinate project activities, assign tasks, and manage the project team to ensure milestones are achieved. Manage changes and adjust project plans as needed to maintain progress. Allocate personnel, equipment, and budget to support project activities, monitoring expenses to ensure adherence to budget constraints. Identify and engage project stakeholders to gather requirements, manage expectations, and communicate progress, risks, and issues transparently. Ensure project deliverables meet defined standards through quality reviews and monitor performance metrics. Implement corrective actions, control critical path, and manage scope changes. Provide periodic project status reports detailing completion percentage, milestones, risks, and issues. Ensure proper project closure by documenting lessons learned and conducting post-implementation reviews. Evaluate project success against objectives and KPIs, and recommend training interventions. A strong understanding of technology project lifecycles and methodologies is essential. The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment is required. 2b2f5d40108fbca8.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is a developer focused on positively shaping living, working, and travel environments. Drive integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, paid media, PR, events, partnerships, website, CRM, email, content, print, film, and experiential channels. Lead the development of annual marketing strategies, go-to-market plans, and asset launch campaigns. Oversee the development of premium sales collateral, digital assets, and brand experiences. Ensure the Red Sea Residences website and digital ecosystem are current, optimized, and aligned with marketing priorities. Establish marketing performance frameworks using data analytics, customer insights, and market intelligence. Lead the planning, execution, and evaluation of international roadshows, exhibitions, and investor events. Minimum of 10 years of progressive marketing experience, preferably within a leading real estate developer, luxury hospitality, destination development, or mixed-use development organization. Minimum of 3–4 years in a managerial or leadership role, leading high-performing marketing teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders. Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated marketing and communications strategies for large-scale, high-value developments or luxury brands. Strong experience within luxury real estate, destination marketing, hospitality, UHNWI, or HNWI sectors is highly preferred. Experience managing significant marketing budgets, agency partnerships, procurement processes, and vendor performance. Demonstrated ability to translate market intelligence and customer insights into commercially successful marketing strategies. Strong stakeholder management skills with experience influencing executive leadership and collaborating across multiple business functions. Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management capabilities. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance creativity, brand equity, customer experience, and measurable business outcomes. Exceptional presentation, communication, negotiation, and strategic planning skills. High level of analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and decision-making capability in fast-paced, complex environments. Strong understanding of emerging marketing technologies, AI-enabled marketing solutions, digital transformation, and evolving media trends. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

2b5e418f78c05c43.description: About the Role Baker Hughes is seeking a Services Specialist Customer Management for a full-time position in Dhahran, Eastern region. 2b6684de7a483b93.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Commercial Director to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on a major infrastructure program for a mixed-use development. The project aims to establish a global landmark in Riyadh, recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination, creating a distinct, self-sustaining hub with iconic assets. Lead and direct contracts, risk, and other support service departments, ensuring timely production of all required commercial deliverables by KBR. 2b9954f6ef47485f.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Director of Sales for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role is responsible for leading the hotel's sales strategy, driving revenue growth, and expanding market share. The Director of Sales will also develop strong relationships with key corporate, government, leisure, MICE, and travel industry partners, overseeing the sales team and ensuring the achievement of revenue goals while maintaining luxury hospitality standards. 2b30e9ec91ab878e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إيدواست عن مهندس ضبط وتحكم في الجودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير وعمليات الجودة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل تنفيذها لضمان الامتثال لأعلى المعايير. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معايير الجودة للمشروعات الهندسية والإشراف على تطبيقها بفعالية. إعداد تقارير مفصلة عن أداء المشاريع وتحديد المراحل الهامة القادمة. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له في سير العمل مع التقدم الفعلي، وتحليل الثغرات وتوضيح المخاطر المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال ضبط الجودة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ضبط وتحكم الجودة، ويفضل أن تكون في المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير وعمليات الجودة وتطبيقاتها. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير واضحة وموجزة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. القدرة على التواصل الفعال كتابياً وشفوياً. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة ديناميكية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في جميع المشاريع الهندسية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. يرجى تقديم طلبك للانضمام إلى فريق شركة إيدواست.

2b9d01de453a00e3.job_title: Engineering Support System (ESS) Reference Data Senior Specialist
2b9d01de453a00e3.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems is the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under Government-to-Government arrangements, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company maintains Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and trains RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia supports the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capability through partnerships and industrialisation. The Role of ESS Business Data Senior Specialist The ESS Business Data Senior Specialist serves as the Team Lead for the Business Data Integrity Team (BDIT) within BAE Systems Saudi Arabia, located in Taif. This full-time role is critical for maintaining the airworthiness of the RSAF Typhoon fleet by ensuring the integrity of engineering records. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and offers a competitive salary. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the BDIT to ensure timely and effective management of all Typhoon aircraft and equipment engineering records, both electronic and hard copy. Act as the focal point within the Technical Support Centre (TSC) for Typhoon BDIT, engaging with the RSAF at all levels to facilitate understanding of BDIT requirements. Liaise with Fleet Management, ESS Reference Data Integrity (DIT) Forward & Depth Maintenance organisations to ensure timely and effective loading of nationalised Technical Instruction and Scheduled Maintenance requirements and updates onto ESS. Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) advice and assistance to ESS Business Data Specialists, ESS New Instruction Record (NIR) Specialists, and ESS Asset Specialists. Oversee BDIT Issue, Asset Management, and NIR Management related activities. Lead activities for developing ESS Application capability for the RSAF, ensuring all improvement requests are validated and authorised before formal release. Conduct testing and evaluation of all application changes prior to embodiment into the RSAF ESS System. Ensure robust 'On the Job' training material is available to enable BDIT staff to perform actions detailed within BDIT process documents. Required Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in data management, engineering records, or a similar field, preferably within an aviation or defence context. Experience in leading a team and managing complex data integrity processes is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Taif, Saudi Arabia, within a critical support function for the Royal Saudi Air Force. The role involves working closely with various internal and external stakeholders, including RSAF personnel.

Translate approved organizational design into an activated operating model, defining roles, structures, decision rights, and ways of working across functions. 2b20e8923d880aae.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية الأداء. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع جميع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة والمواد المستخدمة في نظم التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

2bb2840a4921c867.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة فيصل محمد الجامع للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية عن توفر وظيفة محامي بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتولى المحامي في هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة القضايا، إعداد ملفاتها، وجمع الأدلة والبينات، بالإضافة إلى تسجيل الدعاوى ومتابعتها والترافع فيها أمام مختلف المحاكم. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا وتحليل عناصرها وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحضير البينات والمستندات وكتابة لوائح الدعوى والمذكرات القانونية. تسجيل الدعاوى ومتابعة إجراءات التبليغ وحضور الجلسات والترافع فيها. تقديم الدفوع والمذكرات القانونية حتى صدور الأحكام القضائية. تمثيل الموكلين أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم واللجان القضائية والمحكمين. تقديم الاعتراضات والإنذارات والمطالبات القانونية للموكلين. التفاوض على العقود والاتفاقيات وصياغتها وتوثيقها. المساهمة في استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقة مع عملاء الشركة. المساهمة في تطوير أعمال الشركة بشكل عام. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة أن يكون المتقدم محامياً مرخصاً لدى وزارة العدل. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاماة والاستشارات القانونية. معرفة قوية بالإجراءات القانونية ونظام المحاكم في المملكة العربية السعودية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات عالية في دراسة القضايا وتحليلها وتقديم الرأي القانوني. القدرة على صياغة العقود والمستندات القانونية بدقة واحترافية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تمثيل الموكلين بفعالية أمام الجهات القضائية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بعد المقابلة الشخصية.
